test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
‘A ^ P’ means ‘A is the husband of P’.

‘A % P’ means ‘A is the father of P’.

‘A = P’ means ‘A is the sister of P’.

‘A & P’ means ‘A is the daughter of P’.

If F & G = H ^ J, then which of the following is correct?

options.text: F is the daughter of J.
G is the mother of J.
J is the wife of G’s brother.

solution:
A is

to B

 
 
 

F & G = H ^ J → F is daughter if G, G is sister of H, H is husband of J.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/305ec4ec533b913cbd94224c017067ac390b360353e4d41d972f0c553750dbed.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77c0693017e83559ce467d4d7a6e6c1d7f18342a5bfa7d9b39c64c17945b8408.png] 

1. H and F are siblings. → False (F is niece of H)

2. F is the daughter of J. → False (F is niece of J)

3. G is the mother of J. → False (G is sister-in-law of J)

4. J is the wife of G’s brother. → True

Hence, ‘**J is the wife of G’s brother**’ is the correct answer.
